messages.content_text:
Banger Trade Today
We moved up 300 pt over night so I wasnt expecting much 
But my DOL was higher
I knew wed pullback at open and I was looking for any reason to join into the buying pressure
We pulled back into a 15m FVG and
bounced off .705 of the LTF range
And an SMT with ES
We made a nice 5m hammer but closed red
But made a nice one on 4m that closed green
The CE of 4m RB lined up with .62 of ltf fib
Entered there and road it to the base of the highs for almost 1:8 (edited)
Thursday, January 15, 2026 at 1:02 PM
